outbreak_frequency: Frequent common-source outbreaks reported in Myanmar since 1989; 4 major water-borne outbreaks in the decade to 2000; nearby Singaing township also had a typhoid outbreak
endemicity: Typhoid described as "one of the endemic diseases in Myanmar"; sporadic outbreaks frequently occurred 1989-2000
notes: Recurrence driven by untreated Myaung River water, unsanitary latrines near riverbank, and heavy rain/flooding contaminating river; villages communicate daily enabling spread between townships
